images.label: Surgical_Chamber
images.prompt: A dimly lit underground chamber with cracked concrete walls, flickering neon-blue emergency lights casting long shadows; a pale, bound woman (Lin Xiao) lies on a rusted surgical table, IV tubes snaking from her arms, her eyes wide with silent terror; cyberpunk/sci-fi style, cinematic low-angle composition, high contrast chiaroscuro lighting with cold ambient glow and blood-red accent highlights on metal surfaces.

images.label: Lab_Report
images.prompt: Close-up of a trembling hand holding a printed lab report titled 'Subject 001' in faded ink; background blurred to reveal faint glimpses of occult symbols scrawled on file margins and a drop of dried blood on the paper edge; sci-fi noir style, shallow depth-of-field composition, moody top-down lighting with stark shadow gradients and desaturated teal-and-ash color palette.

images.label: Factory_Ritual
images.prompt: Abandoned industrial factory at night: shattered skylights leak moonlight onto dusty machinery; silhouettes of armed operatives crouch behind corroded conveyor belts, aiming toward a distant ritual circle glowing with unstable violet energy; anime-meets-cyberpunk style, wide dynamic composition, dramatic backlighting from the anomaly, deep indigo shadows, volumetric dust particles, cinematic tension.
